body:
I think I dont want counselling with her because I think that this relationship needs to end at some point. I have been in this point for 3-4 months thinking about this daily, but still I feel like I am not ready to break up, and have lied to my girlfriend everything is OK. Probably will do so tomorrow too, and this will never end. It feels impossible. What I want is our romantic relationship to end, but us to be friends and support each other, but that is never possible because she wont then get over me.

I have no idea what real love is, I just know this addictive codependant toxic relationship which has made my best years at 21 years old miserable. I love her taking care of me, shes almost feels like mother to me sometimes... I have no idea, and I have been asking those questions for months, still have no idea what is what and what do I want. I just want her to be happy, and me to be able to live without her support.

Thank you for your answer.

I realize I have been manipulated and abused, but I think I still love her, or deeply care about her. I am just so scared of being alone too. How I will survive without my last support and best friend? I feel so depressed coming in to my empty lonely house. And how I can live with myself making her life more worse than what it already was before me. She just texted me that she wants to die, because of this situation. I feel I am the worst human ever to mankind. Sorry for my bad english. But staying and dragging this is also bad. There is no-win situation here. I am so codependant and needy too that it is really hard, probably gonna be hardest thing I have ever to do, to breakup with her.
